title: Rajasthan RSSB Clerk Gr-II/ Junior Assistant  Exam Date/ Admit Card 2026 for 10644 Post
intro: Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB/ RMSSSB) has Officially Released Exam Date/ Admit Card for the Post of Clerk Gr-II/ Junior Assistant Advt.No. 04/2026 Recruitment 2026 for 10644 Post. Online Application Start on January 15, 2026 & Last Date is February 13, 2026 @ 11:59 PM. All Interested Candidates Can Download Exam Date/ Admit Card Now in The Given Link Below.
importantDates: OBC/ EBC/ EWS/ SC/ ST of Raj. Rs.400/-
Payment Mode: Pay the Exam Fee through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, Fee Mode Only.
Note: This fee is for one time registration, now the candidate will not have to pay the application fee again and again after paying the OTR fee once.
Age Relaxation Extra as Per Rules.
Senior Secondary (12th Grade) pass from a recognized Board or its equivalent.

You must possess at least one of the following technical qualifications: (i) NIELIT (DOEACC): "O" or Higher Level certificate. (ii) NIELIT (New Delhi): Certificate course on Computer Concept (CCC). (iii) COPA/DPCS: Computer Operator & Programming Assistant or Data Preparation and Computer Software certificate. (iv) Higher Education: Degree, Diploma, or Certificate in Computer Science / Computer Application from a recognized university. (v) School Subject: Senior Secondary Certificate with Computer Science or Computer Application as a subject. (vi) Polytechnic: Diploma in Computer Science & Engineering. (vii) RSCIT: Rajasthan State Certificate Course in Information Technology conducted by VMOU, Kota. (viii) Equivalent: Any other equivalent or higher qualification recognized by the government.
Knowledge of working in written Hindi in Devnagari script and knowledge of Rajasthan culture.
RSSB CET Common Eligibility Test (12th Level) 2024
For More Details, Read the Official Notification.
Mode of Selection: Selection on the basis of Written Exam, DV & Merit List.
13 February 2026: Last date for registration and fee payment.
To Be Notified: Admit card release.
Age Relaxation: Extra as per rules.

Educational Qualification: Senior Secondary (12th) pass from recognized board + one of the following computer qualifications: RSCIT (VMOU Kota), CCC, O level, COPA/DPCS, Diploma/Degree in Computer Science, Senior Secondary with Computer Science, or equivalent.
Knowledge: Working knowledge of Hindi in Devnagari script + knowledge of Rajasthan culture.
Mandatory: Rajasthan CET (Common Eligibility Test) 12th Level 2024 qualified.
Mode of Selection: Written Exam + DV + Merit List
Huge Vacancy: 10644 posts in Rajasthan govt
